why_this_file_exists: Not because the fact is hard to find -- it is one glance at a photograph for anybody with a browser. It is because this desk cannot see one unaided. Every headshot host is refused by the container's egress proxy (the NFL CDN, ESPN, the Sleeper CDN), and web search returns text: it will confirm a height and a weight and a college, and it will not tell you a man's skin colour, because no source writes that down. Saying the fact was unobtainable was wrong; the honest version is that it is not obtainable FROM HERE without help.
two_ways_to_fill_it: John writes one line, as he did for all eight of week 7.

John drops the player's photograph into the chat. Images pasted into the conversation ARE visible to this desk -- that is how every cover and every play picture got judged -- so a headshot can be read directly and the line written from it rather than from a description of it.
